auth_failed: That did not work. Try again.
not_operator_title: This account does not run the instance
not_operator_body: You are signed in as {name}, {email}. An operator is named from the server, with this command:
not_operator_write: It says which account it found. Run it again with --write to make that account an operator, then reload this page.
copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
developers_empty: No developer account yet. Create one for whoever consumes the API, then make it a key.
developer_contact_hint: How you reach whoever holds the keys. Yours to leave out.
developer_limit_hint: Shared by the account's keys. Leave it empty for no limit.
developer_limit_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 999,999, or nothing.
developer_delete_body: Its keys stop working at once, and its keys and their counts are deleted. To stop an account and keep its history, suspend it instead.
orphan_keys_body: An earlier version of the instance made these keys. They work without a limit. Revoke them, and make new ones for a developer account.
key_new_body: For {developer}. It reads the data everyone shares, and nothing of an account.
key_name_hint: The program that will hold it, such as "tide clock".
key_made_body: This is the only time "{name}" is shown: the instance keeps its hash, not the key.
key_revoke_body: The key stops working at once, and never works again.
usage_chart_label: Calls from {start} to {end}, answered and not answered
usage_empty: No call in this span of time.
usage_empty_keys: No call with a key in this span of time.
outcome_invalid_hint: The request was wrong: something missing, or something that does not exist.
outcome_refused_hint: The caller was not accepted: no name, a key that does not work, or no right to this.
outcome_limited_hint: The developer account had made its calls for the hour.
outcome_failed_hint: The instance failed: a fault of its own, or a provider that did not answer.
